DATASTORES & PLAYER DATA:

BASIC DATASTORE:
local DSS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local store = DSS:GetDataStore("PlayerData_v2")

local DEFAULT_DATA = {
    coins = 0,
    level = 1,
    experience = 0,
    inventory = {},
    settings = {music = true, sfx = true},
    statistics = {
        kills = 0,
        deaths = 0,
        playtime = 0,
        gamesPlayed = 0
    },
    achievements = {},
    lastLogin = 0
}

local function loadData(player)
    local userId = player.UserId
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return store:GetAsync(userId)
    end)
    
    if success and data then
        for key, value in pairs(DEFAULT_DATA) do
            if data[key] == nil then
                data[key] = value
            end
        end
        data.lastLogin = os.time()
        return data
    else
        warn("Failed to load:", player.Name)
        return DEFAULT_DATA
    end
end

local function saveData(player, data)
    local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
        store:SetAsync(player.UserId, data)
    end)
    
    if success then
        print("✅ Saved:", player.Name)
    else
        warn("❌ Failed to save:", player.Name, errorMsg)
        -- Retry logic
        task.wait(1)
        pcall(function()
            store:SetAsync(player.UserId, data)
        end)
    end
    return success
end

ORDERED DATASTORE (LEADERBOARDS):
local leaderboard = DSS:GetOrderedDataStore("GlobalLeaderboard")

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, score)
    pcall(function()
        leaderboard:SetAsync(tostring(userId), score)
    end)
end

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return leaderboard:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then return {} end
    
    local topPlayers = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
        table.insert(topPlayers, {
            userId = tonumber(entry.key),
            score = entry.value
        })
    end
    return topPlayers
end

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local DAMAGE_TYPES = {
    normal = {color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), multiplier = 1},
    critical = {color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0), multiplier = 2},
    headshot = {color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255), multiplier = 2.5}
}

local function createIndicator(character, damage, damageType)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    
    local typeInfo = DAMAGE_TYPES[damageType] or DAMAGE_TYPES.normal
    
    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 50)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = head
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = "-" .. tostring(math.floor(damage))
    label.TextColor3 = typeInfo.color
    label.TextSize = damageType == "critical" and 32 or 24
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
    label.Parent = billboard
    
    local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local tween = TS:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(1), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, -1, 0),
        TextTransparency = 1
    })
    tween:Play()
    
    Debris:AddItem(billboard, 1.5)
end

local function applyDamage(attacker, victim, amount, damageType)
    if not victim or not victim:IsA("Model") then return false end
    
    local humanoid = victim:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    
    local attackerPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attacker)
    local victimPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(victim)
    
    if attackerPlayer and victimPlayer then
        if attackerPlayer.Team == victimPlayer.Team then
            return false
        end
    end
    
    local typeInfo = DAMAGE_TYPES[damageType] or DAMAGE_TYPES.normal
    local finalDamage = amount * typeInfo.multiplier
    
    humanoid:TakeDamage(finalDamage)
    createIndicator(victim, finalDamage, damageType)
    
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        if attackerPlayer and victimPlayer then
            local attackerStats = attackerPlayer.leaderstats
            if attackerStats then
                attackerStats.Kills.Value += 1
            end
            
            local victimStats = victimPlayer.leaderstats
            if victimStats then
                victimStats.Deaths.Value += 1
            end
            
            print(attackerPlayer.Name, "eliminated", victimPlayer.Name)
        end
    end
    
    return true
end

damageEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target, damage, damageType)
    if not player.Character then return end
    if not target or not target:IsA("Model") then return end
    
    local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHrp = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if hrp and targetHrp then
        local distance = (hrp.Position - targetHrp.Position).Magnitude
        if distance > 150 then
            warn("⚠️ Too far:", player.Name, distance)
            return
        end
    end
    
    if typeof(damage) ~= "number" or damage < 0 or damage > 100 then
        warn("⚠️ Invalid damage:", player.Name, damage)
        return
    end
    
    applyDamage(player.Character, target, damage, damageType)
end)

local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function tweenPart(part, duration, properties, style, direction)
    local info = TweenInfo.new(
        duration or 1,
        style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
        direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
        0, false, 0
    )
    
    local tween = TS:Create(part, info, properties)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
end

CHAIN TWEENS:
local function chainTweens(part, tweenData)
    local function playNext(index)
        if index > #tweenData then return end
        
        local data = tweenData[index]
        local tween = tweenPart(part, data.duration, data.properties, data.style)
        
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if data.callback then
                data.callback()
            end
            playNext(index + 1)
        end)
    end
    
    playNext(1)
end

chainTweens(workspace.Part, {
    {duration = 1, properties = {Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)}},
    {duration = 0.5, properties = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)}},
    {duration = 1, properties = {Transparency = 1}, callback = function()
        print("Animation complete!")
    end}
})

local function followPath(part, waypoints, speed)

        Size = originalSize * 1.2

PULSE ANIMATION:
local function pulseAnimation(part)
    task.spawn(function()
        while part and part.Parent do
            local tween = tweenPart(part, 1, {
                Size = part.Size * 1.1,
                Transparency = 0.3
            }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
            
            tween.Completed:Wait()
            
            local tween2 = tweenPart(part, 1, {
                Size = part.Size / 1.1,
                Transparency = 0
            }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
            
            tween2.Completed:Wait()
        end
    end)
end

CAMERA SHAKE:
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function cameraShake(intensity, duration)
    local originalCF = camera.CFrame
    local elapsed = 0
    
    while elapsed < duration do
        local shake = Vector3.new(
            math.random(-intensity, intensity),
            math.random(-intensity, intensity),
            math.random(-intensity, intensity)
        ) * 0.1
        
        camera.CFrame = originalCF * CFrame.new(shake)
        elapsed += task.wait()
    end
    
    camera.CFrame = originalCF
end

        maxStack = 1,
        category = "weapon",
        rarity = "legendary",
        weight = 8,
        stats = {damage = 35, durability = 500}
    }
}

function Inventory.new(player, maxSlots, maxWeight)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Inventory)
    self.player = player
    self.maxSlots = maxSlots or 20
    self.maxWeight = maxWeight or 100
    self.currentWeight = 0
    self.slots = {}
    
    for i = 1, self.maxSlots do
        self.slots[i] = {item = nil, quantity = 0}
    end
    
    return self
end

function Inventory:AddItem(itemName, quantity)
    quantity = quantity or 1
    
    if not ITEMS_DATABASE[itemName] then
        return false, "Invalid item"
    end
    
    local itemData = ITEMS_DATABASE[itemName]
    local totalWeight = self.currentWeight + (itemData.weight * quantity)
    
    if totalWeight > self.maxWeight then
        return false, "Too heavy"
    end
    
    local remainingQty = quantity
    
    for i, slot in ipairs(self.slots) do
        if slot.item == itemName and slot.quantity < itemData.maxStack then
            local space = itemData.maxStack - slot.quantity
            local toAdd = math.min(space, remainingQty)
            
            slot.quantity += toAdd
            remainingQty -= toAdd
            self.currentWeight += itemData.weight * toAdd
            
            if remainingQty <= 0 then
                return true, "Added to existing stack"
            end
        end
    end
    
    while remainingQty > 0 do
        local emptySlot = self:GetEmptySlot()
        if not emptySlot then
            return false, "Inventory full"
        end
        
        local toAdd = math.min(itemData.maxStack, remainingQty)
        self.slots[emptySlot].item = itemName
        self.slots[emptySlot].quantity = toAdd
        remainingQty -= toAdd
        self.currentWeight += itemData.weight * toAdd
    end
    
    return true, "Added to inventory"
end

function Inventory:RemoveItem(itemName, quantity)
    quantity = quantity or 1
    
    local total = self:GetItemQuantity(itemName)
    if total < quantity then
        return false, "Not enough items"
    end
    
    local remaining = quantity
    local itemData = ITEMS_DATABASE[itemName]
    
    for i, slot in ipairs(self.slots) do
        if slot.item == itemName and remaining > 0 then
            local toRemove = math.min(slot.quantity, remaining)
            slot.quantity -= toRemove
            remaining -= toRemove
            self.currentWeight -= itemData.weight * toRemove
            
            if slot.quantity <= 0 then
                slot.item = nil
                slot.quantity = 0
            end
        end
    end
    
    return true, "Removed from inventory"
end

function Inventory:GetItemQuantity(itemName)
    local total = 0
    for _, slot in ipairs(self.slots) do
        if slot.item == itemName then
            total += slot.quantity
        end
    end
    return total
end

function Inventory:GetEmptySlot()
    for i, slot in ipairs(self.slots) do
        if slot.item == nil then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function Inventory:HasItem(itemName, quantity)
    quantity = quantity or 1
    return self:GetItemQuantity(itemName) >= quantity
end

function Inventory:GetItemsByCategory(category)
    local items = {}
    for _, slot in ipairs(self.slots) do
        if slot.item then
            local itemData = ITEMS_DATABASE[slot.item]
            if itemData.category == category then
                table.insert(items, {
                    name = slot.item,
                    quantity = slot.quantity,
                    data = itemData
                })
            end
        end
    end
    return items
end

function Inventory:GetAllItems()
    local items = {}
    for i, slot in ipairs(self.slots) do
        if slot.item then
            table.insert(items, {
                slot = i,
                name = slot.item,
                quantity = slot.quantity,
                data = ITEMS_DATABASE[slot.item]
            })
        end
    end
    return items
end

function Inventory:SortByRarity()
    local rarityOrder = {common = 1, uncommon = 2, rare = 3, epic = 4, legendary = 5}
    
    local items = self:GetAllItems()
    table.sort(items, function(a, b)
        return (rarityOrder[a.data.rarity] or 0) > (rarityOrder[b.data.rarity] or 0)
    end)
    
    for i = 1, self.maxSlots do
        self.slots[i] = {item = nil, quantity = 0}
    end
    
    for i, itemData in ipairs(items) do
        if i <= self.maxSlots then
            self.slots[i] = {item = itemData.name, quantity = itemData.quantity}
        end
    end
end

return Inventory

function ObjectPool.new(template, initialSize)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ObjectPool)
    self.template = template
    self.available = {}
    self.inUse = {}
    self.totalCreated = 0
    
    for i = 1, initialSize or 10 do
        local obj = template:Clone()
        obj.Parent = nil
        table.insert(self.available, obj)
        self.totalCreated += 1
    end
    
    return self
end

function ObjectPool:Get()
    local obj
    
    if #self.available > 0 then
        obj = table.remove(self.available)
    else
        obj = self.template:Clone()
        self.totalCreated += 1
        warn("Pool exhausted, created new object. Total:", self.totalCreated)
    end
    
    table.insert(self.inUse, obj)
    return obj
end

function ObjectPool:Return(obj)
    obj.Parent = nil
    
    for i, o in ipairs(self.inUse) do
        if o == obj then
            table.remove(self.inUse, i)
            break
        end
    end
    
    if #self.available < 50 then
        table.insert(self.available, obj)
    else
        obj:Destroy()
        self.totalCreated -= 1
    end
end

        inUse = #self.inUse,

STATE MACHINE:
local StateMachine = {}
StateMachine.__index = StateMachine

function StateMachine.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, StateMachine)
    self.currentState = nil
    self.states = {}
    self.history = {}
    return self
end

function StateMachine:AddState(name, onEnter, onUpdate, onExit)
    self.states[name] = {
        enter = onEnter or function() end,
        update = onUpdate or function() end,
        exit = onExit or function() end
    }
end

function StateMachine:ChangeState(newState)
    if self.currentState == newState then return end
    
    if self.currentState and self.states[self.currentState] then
        self.states[self.currentState].exit()
    end
    
    table.insert(self.history, {state = newState, time = tick()})
    
    self.currentState = newState
    
    if self.states[newState] then
        self.states[newState].enter()
    end
end

function StateMachine:Update(deltaTime)
    if self.currentState and self.states[self.currentState] then
        self.states[self.currentState].update(deltaTime)
    end
end

function StateMachine:GetHistory()
    return self.history
end

return StateMachine

local Signal = {}

function Signal.new()

    self._connections = {}
    self._queue = {}
    return self
end

function Signal:Connect(callback)
    if typeof(callback) ~= "function" then
        error("Callback must be a function")
    end
    
    local connection = {
        callback = callback,
        connected = true
    }
    
    table.insert(self._connections, connection)
    
    return {
        Disconnect = function()
            connection.connected = false
            for i, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
                if conn == connection then
                    table.remove(self._connections, i)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    }
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
    for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
        if conn.connected then
            task.spawn(conn.callback, ...)
        end
    end
end

function Signal:Wait()
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    local connection
    connection = self:Connect(function(...)
        connection:Disconnect()
        task.spawn(thread, ...)
    end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
    for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections) do
        conn.connected = false
    end
    self._connections = {}
end

function Promise.new(executor)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Promise)
    self._state = "pending"
    self._value = nil
    self._callbacks = {}
    
    local function resolve(value)
        if self._state ~= "pending" then return end
        self._state = "resolved"
        self._value = value
        
        for _, callback in ipairs(self._callbacks) do
            task.spawn(callback, value)
        end
    end
    
    local function reject(reason)
        if self._state ~= "pending" then return end
        self._state = "rejected"
        self._value = reason
    end
    
    task.spawn(executor, resolve, reject)
    return self
end

function Promise:andThen(callback)
    if self._state == "resolved" then
        task.spawn(callback, self._value)
    elseif self._state == "pending" then
        table.insert(self._callbacks, callback)
    end
    return self
end

return Promise

function ParticleSystem:Emit()
    for i = 1, self.config.count do

        particle.Size = Vector3.new(self.config.size, self.config.size, self.config.size)
        particle.Position = self.origin
        particle.Anchored = false
        particle.CanCollide = false
        particle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        particle.Color = self.config.color
        particle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        particle.Parent = workspace
        
        local angle = math.rad(math.random(0, self.config.spread))
        local direction = Vector3.new(
            math.cos(angle),
            math.random(0, 10) / 10,
            math.sin(angle)
        )
        
        particle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * self.config.speed
        
        table.insert(self.particles, {
            part = particle,
            lifetime = self.config.lifetime,
            created = tick()
        })
    end

function ParticleSystem:Update(deltaTime)
    for i = #self.particles, 1, -1 do
        local p = self.particles[i]
        local age = tick() - p.created
        
        if age >= p.lifetime then
            p.part:Destroy()
            table.remove(self.particles, i)
        else
            local alpha = age / p.lifetime
            p.part.Transparency = alpha
            
            p.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = p.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity + Vector3.new(0, self.config.gravity * deltaTime, 0)
        end
    end

local function simulateProjectile(origin, velocity, gravity, lifetime)
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    projectile.Position = origin
    projectile.Anchored = true
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local startTime = tick()
    local currentVelocity = velocity
    
    local function update()
        local elapsed = tick() - startTime
        
        if elapsed >= lifetime then
            projectile:Destroy()
            return
        end
        
        currentVelocity = currentVelocity + (gravity * (1/60))
        projectile.Position = projectile.Position + (currentVelocity * (1/60))
        
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {projectile}
        
        local result = workspace:Raycast(
            projectile.Position,
            currentVelocity.Unit * 2,
            params
        )
        
        if result then
            local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
            explosion.Position = result.Position
            explosion.BlastRadius = 10
            explosion.BlastPressure = 100000
            explosion.Parent = workspace
            
            projectile:Destroy()
            return
        end
    end
    
    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(update)
end

GRAVITY SIMULATION:
local function applyCustomGravity(part, gravityStrength, gravityDirection)
    local bodyForce = Instance.new("BodyForce")
    bodyForce.Force = gravityDirection * gravityStrength * part:GetMass()
    bodyForce.Parent = part
    
    return bodyForce
end

local blackHole = workspace.BlackHole
local GRAVITY_STRENGTH = 1000

game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                local direction = (blackHole.Position - hrp.Position).Unit
                local distance = (blackHole.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity + (direction * force * (1/60))
            end
        end
    end
end)

WAVE SIMULATION:
local function createWave(parts, amplitude, frequency, speed)
    local startTime = tick()
    
    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local elapsed = tick() - startTime
        
        for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
            local offset = math.sin((i * frequency) + (elapsed * speed)) * amplitude
            part.Position = Vector3.new(part.Position.X, offset, part.Position.Z)
        end
    end)
end

FLOCKING BEHAVIOR (BOIDS):
local Boid = {}
Boid.__index = Boid

function Boid.new(position)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Boid)
    self.position = position
    self.velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 0, math.random(-5, 5))
    self.acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    self.maxSpeed = 10
    self.maxForce = 0.5
    
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.5, 2)
    part.Position = position
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.Parent = workspace
    self.part = part
    
    return self
end

function Boid:Flock(boids)
    local separation = self:Separate(boids)
    local alignment = self:Align(boids)
    local cohesion = self:Cohesion(boids)
    
    separation = separation * 1.5
    alignment = alignment * 1.0
    cohesion = cohesion * 1.0
    
    self.acceleration = self.acceleration + separation + alignment + cohesion
end

function Boid:Separate(boids)
    local desiredSeparation = 5
    local steer = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local count = 0
    
    for _, other in ipairs(boids) do
        local d = (self.position - other.position).Magnitude
        if d > 0 and d < desiredSeparation then
            local diff = (self.position - other.position).Unit / d
            steer = steer + diff
            count += 1
        end
    end
    
    if count > 0 then
        steer = steer / count
    end
    
    return steer
end

function Boid:Align(boids)
    local neighborDist = 10
    local sum = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local count = 0
    
    for _, other in ipairs(boids) do
        local d = (self.position - other.position).Magnitude
        if d > 0 and d < neighborDist then
            sum = sum + other.velocity
            count += 1
        end
    end
    
    if count > 0 then
        sum = sum / count
        return sum.Unit * self.maxSpeed
    end
    
    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

function Boid:Cohesion(boids)
    local neighborDist = 10
    local sum = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local count = 0
    
    for _, other in ipairs(boids) do
        local d = (self.position - other.position).Magnitude
        if d > 0 and d < neighborDist then
            sum = sum + other.position
            count += 1
        end
    end
    
    if count > 0 then
        sum = sum / count
        return (sum - self.position).Unit
    end
    
    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

function Boid:Update()
    self.velocity = self.velocity + self.acceleration
    
    if self.velocity.Magnitude > self.maxSpeed then
        self.velocity = self.velocity.Unit * self.maxSpeed
    end
    
    self.position = self.position + self.velocity * (1/60)
    self.acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    self.part.Position = self.position
    self.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(self.position, self.position + self.velocity)
end

PATHFINDING:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local function findPath(start, finish, agentParams)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath(agentParams or {
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        WaypointSpacing = 4,
        Costs = {
            Water = 20
        }
    })
    
    local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(start, finish)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        return path:GetWaypoints()
    else
        warn("Path failed:", errorMsg)
        return nil
    end
end

local function followPath(humanoid, waypoints)
    for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
        if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
        
        humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
        humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
    end
end
